title: 水力模型縮尺試驗
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways
summary: 本課以非扭曲自由水面重力模型為主軸，逐步推導幾何、速度、流量、時間、壓力與合力比例，再檢查雷諾數、韋伯數及量測誤差無法自動相似的部分。十個單元要求先說明研究目的與控制尺度，再判斷哪些結果可量化放大，哪些只能定性比較，避免以模型照片漂亮取代實驗驗證。
summaryEn: An undistorted gravity-driven free-surface model provides the main thread. Units derive geometry, velocity, discharge, time, pressure and force scales, then examine Reynolds and Weber mismatches and measurement uncertainty. Apprentices define the question and controlling length before deciding which results support quantitative extrapolation and which allow only qualitative comparison.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「幾何比例與控制長度」與「重力流速度比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Geometry ratio and reference length" and "Velocity scaling for gravity flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 幾何比例與控制長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry ratio and reference length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何比例與控制長度」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometry ratio and reference length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。非扭曲模型各方向採同一比例，局部粗糙、縫隙與邊界若無法製作應記錄；改用垂直水平不同比例時，速度與輸砂關係必須重新推導。 假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何比例與控制長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization. An undistorted model uses one ratio in all directions, documenting roughness, gaps or boundaries that cannot be reproduced. Different vertical and horizontal scales require rederived velocity and sediment relationships, so they cannot be introduced quietly while retaining undistorted-model formulas. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometry ratio and reference length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何比例與控制長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometry ratio and reference length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 幾何比例與控制長度
knowledge.text: 縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。非扭曲模型各方向採同一比例，局部粗糙、縫隙與邊界若無法製作應記錄；改用垂直水平不同比例時，速度與輸砂關係必須重新推導。
knowledge.textEn: A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization. An undistorted model uses one ratio in all directions, documenting roughness, gaps or boundaries that cannot be reproduced.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「幾何比例與控制長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geometry ratio and reference length" is correct?
options: 只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。
縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。
佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。
optionsEn: Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales.
A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization.
Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length.
quiz.explanation: 縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 幾何比例與控制長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometry ratio and reference length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何比例與控制長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometry ratio and reference length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「幾何比例與控制長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometry ratio and reference length", which statement holds?
options: 只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。
縮尺合力只需要跟長度成正比而不必考慮受壓面積。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Rescaling the recorded time axis repairs any valve motion that was not correctly scaled during the test.
Model force scales only linearly with length and does not depend on loaded area.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 幾何比例與控制長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometry ratio and reference length: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「幾何比例與控制長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometry ratio and reference length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。確認是否有扭曲尺度，將無法按比例製作的縫隙獨立標出，說明可能影響哪一項觀察量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings. Identify any distorted scale and separately mark gaps that cannot be reproduced, explaining which observed quantities their mismatch could influence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。確認是否有扭曲尺度，將無法按比例製作的縫隙獨立標出，說明可能影響哪一項觀察量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings. Identify any distorted scale and separately mark gaps that cannot be reproduced, explaining which observed quantities their mismatch could influence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：微小閘縫若在模型被封死會改變漏流，轉角磨圓則可能改變分離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Closing a tiny modeled gate gap changes leakage, while rounded corners alter separation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。確認是否有扭曲尺度，將無法按比例製作的縫隙獨立標出，說明可能影響哪一項觀察量。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings. Identify any distorted scale and separately mark gaps that cannot be reproduced, explaining which observed quantities their mismatch could influence.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。確認是否有扭曲尺度，將無法按比例製作的縫隙獨立標出，說明可能影響哪一項觀察量。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings. Identify any distorted scale and separately mark gaps that cannot be reproduced, explaining which observed quantities their mismatch could influence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「幾何比例與控制長度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Geometry ratio and reference length"?
options: 把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。
optionsEn: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable.
quiz.explanation: 把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 幾何比例與控制長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometry ratio and reference length: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何比例與控制長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometry ratio and reference length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 微小閘縫若在模型被封死會改變漏流，轉角磨圓則可能改變分離。外觀相似但垂直尺度偷偷不同時，原本的相似律不再適用，結果仍可能看起來很合理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Closing a tiny modeled gate gap changes leakage, while rounded corners alter separation. A visually similar model with an undisclosed vertical-scale change violates the original similarity assumptions even when its output appears plausible. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 微小閘縫若在模型被封死會改變漏流，轉角磨圓則可能改變分離。外觀相似但垂直尺度偷偷不同時，原本的相似律不再適用，結果仍可能看起來很合理。
knowledge.textEn: Closing a tiny modeled gate gap changes leakage, while rounded corners alter separation. A visually similar model with an undisclosed vertical-scale change violates the original similarity assumptions even when its output appears plausible.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「幾何比例與控制長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Geometry ratio and reference length" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
微小閘縫若在模型被封死會改變漏流，轉角磨圓則可能改變分離。
佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Closing a tiny modeled gate gap changes leakage, while rounded corners alter separation.
Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length.
quiz.explanation: 微小閘縫若在模型被封死會改變漏流，轉角磨圓則可能改變分離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Closing a tiny modeled gate gap changes leakage, while rounded corners alter separation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重力流速度比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity scaling for gravity flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重力流速度比例」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由水面重力主導時以佛祿數相等建立速度比例，必須確認原型與模型使用相同重力場。此時速度不是隨長度線性縮小，且黏滯或表面張力主導的小尺度區仍可能失真；同一速度比例也不能無條件套到加壓水錘或可壓縮氣流。 假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力流速度比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For gravity-dominated free surfaces, equal Froude numbers determine velocity scaling under equal gravity. Velocity does not shrink linearly with length, and small viscous or capillary regions may remain distorted. The same relation cannot automatically describe pressurized water hammer or compressible air, whose controlling physics and required similarity parameters differ from the chosen free-surface experiment. Assume length ratio40 and Froude similarity. Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重力流速度比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity scaling for gravity flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重力流速度比例
knowledge.text: 自由水面重力主導時以佛祿數相等建立速度比例，必須確認原型與模型使用相同重力場。此時速度不是隨長度線性縮小，且黏滯或表面張力主導的小尺度區仍可能失真；同一速度比例也不能無條件套到加壓水錘或可壓縮氣流。
knowledge.textEn: For gravity-dominated free surfaces, equal Froude numbers determine velocity scaling under equal gravity. Velocity does not shrink linearly with length, and small viscous or capillary regions may remain distorted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重力流速度比例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Velocity scaling for gravity flow" is correct?
options: 佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。
總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。
自由水面重力主導時以佛祿數相等建立速度比例，必須確認原型與模型使用相同重力場。
optionsEn: Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length.
Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
For gravity-dominated free surfaces, equal Froude numbers determine velocity scaling under equal gravity.
quiz.explanation: 自由水面重力主導時以佛祿數相等建立速度比例，必須確認原型與模型使用相同重力場。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For gravity-dominated free surfaces, equal Froude numbers determine velocity scaling under equal gravity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重力流速度比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Velocity scaling for gravity flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重力流速度比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and Froude similarity. Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and Froude similarity. Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重力流速度比例」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Velocity scaling for gravity flow", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
重力壓力比例正確就表示空化與封閉氣泡壓縮也完全相似。
模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Correct gravity-pressure scaling proves that cavitation and trapped-air compression are also fully similar.
A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重力流速度比例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Velocity scaling for gravity flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重力流速度比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。再估黏滯與表面張力影響範圍，區分局部薄水層和主要流區，不以整體相似掩蓋小尺度區域的失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations. Estimate where viscosity and surface tension matter, separating thin local layers from the main flow rather than hiding small-scale distortion behind a matching global similarity parameter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。再估黏滯與表面張力影響範圍，區分局部薄水層和主要流區，不以整體相似掩蓋小尺度區域的失真。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations. Estimate where viscosity and surface tension matter, separating thin local layers from the main flow rather than hiding small-scale distortion behind a matching global similarity parameter.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。再估黏滯與表面張力影響範圍，區分局部薄水層和主要流區，不以整體相似掩蓋小尺度區域的失真。
knowledge.textEn: Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations. Estimate where viscosity and surface tension matter, separating thin local layers from the main flow rather than hiding small-scale distortion behind a matching global similarity parameter.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。再估黏滯與表面張力影響範圍，區分局部薄水層和主要流區，不以整體相似掩蓋小尺度區域的失真。
knowledge.textEn: Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations. Estimate where viscosity and surface tension matter, separating thin local layers from the main flow rather than hiding small-scale distortion behind a matching global similarity parameter.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重力流速度比例」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Velocity scaling for gravity flow"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。
模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations.
A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale.
quiz.explanation: 分別用原型與模型水深計算佛祿數，查核速度量測位置是否對應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute Froude numbers independently using corresponding depths and velocity locations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重力流速度比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Velocity scaling for gravity flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重力流速度比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。局部黏性控制區即使佛祿數正確，壓力和渦流仍未必可直接放大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. Locally viscous regions can still have unrepresentative pressures and vortices despite equal Froude numbers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。局部黏性控制區即使佛祿數正確，壓力和渦流仍未必可直接放大。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. Locally viscous regions can still have unrepresentative pressures and vortices despite equal Froude numbers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重力流速度比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Velocity scaling for gravity flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。
將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth.
quiz.explanation: 將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
